## 2. Per-game template (identical shape for all 14)

```
[GameName]/
├── index.js            # public entry — implements the GameContract below
├── [GameName]Game.js   # state machine (READY / PLAYING / PAUSED / GAMEOVER), rules, scoring
├── config.js           # every tunable constant in one place
├── entities/           # game-specific actors (player, enemies, projectiles)
├── world/              # arena geometry, procedural level generation
└── systems/            # (optional) game-specific logic, e.g. Tetris piece rotation
```

Import depth is capped at one level up: `../shared/core/GameLoop.js`. Games never import from other games; `shared/` never imports from any game.

## 3. Vite setup

- **`package.json`** — `"type": "module"`, scripts `dev` / `build` / `preview`. Runtime deps: `three` only. No physics engine, no asset pipeline, no other runtime packages.
- **`index.html`** — a single `<div id="app">` plus one module script. The launcher renders the glassmorphism menu of all 14 titles; selecting one sets `location.hash = '#/Pong'` and the router does `import('./Pong/index.js')`.
- **Three.js addons** resolve through the package's own exports map — `three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js`, `three/addons/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js`, `three/addons/postprocessing/OutputPass.js`. No CDN, no bundler plugins.

## 4. Game contract (the launcher↔game seam)

Every `[GameName]/index.js` exports exactly:

```js
export default {
  name: 'PONG',
  create(rootEl) → { start(), pause(), resume(), destroy() }
}
```

`destroy()` is the leak-prevention contract: stop the loop, detach input listeners, cancel audio, and dispose **every** geometry / material / texture / composer pass through the `MemoryRegistry`. Switching games from the launcher must leave zero live GPU resources behind.

## 5. Shared-utility strategy (APIs pinned now, implemented in STEP 3)

| Module | Public surface (what games may call) |
|---|---|
| `GameLoop` | `start(update)`, `stop()`, `pause()/resume()`, `setTimescale(t)`, `onPause` — fixed 1/60 step, accumulator, delta clamped; hit-stop rides on `setTimescale` |
| `EventBus` | `on / once / off / emit / clear` |
| `ObjectPool` | `new ObjectPool(factory, resetFn, initialSize)` → `acquire()`, `release(obj)`, `releaseAll()`, `activeCount` |
| `MemoryRegistry` | `track(res)`, `dispose(res)`, `disposeAll()` — the single source of truth for GPU resource lifetimes |
| `InputController` | `attach()/detach()`, `poll()`, `axisX/axisY`, `fire/firePressed/pausePressed/startPressed`, `vibrate(intensity, ms)`, `isGamepadActive` — deadzone 0.2, per-frame edge detection, identical semantics for keyboard and gamepad |
| `RendererFactory` | `createRenderer()`, `createCamera()`, `bindResize(renderer, camera, cb)` |
| `PostFX` | `constructor(renderer, scene, camera)`, `setBloom({strength, radius, threshold})`, `render()`, `dispose()` — bloom threshold tuned so only emissive surfaces glow, never washes to white |
| `CameraRig` | `addTrauma(amount)`, `kick(velocity)`, `follow(target, offset, damping)`, `update(dt, t)`, `reset()` — amplitude = trauma², noise-driven direction |
| `ParticleManager` | `burst({position, count, velocity, spread, color, size, life, gravity, drag})`, `update(dt)`, `clear()`, `dispose()` — SoA typed arrays, one `InstancedMesh`, hard cap 500, oldest-steal when saturated |
| `ShockwaveRingPool` | `spawn({position, axis, maxRadius, color, duration})`, `update(dt)`, `dispose()` |
| `MotionTrailPool` | `attach(target, {length, color})`, `detach(target)`, `update(dt)`, `dispose()` — fixed-vertex ribbon, tapered width, additive emissive |
| `FloatingTextPool` | `spawn({text, position, color, size, life, mode:'3d'|'html'})`, `update(dt, camera)`, `dispose()` |
| `AudioEngine` | `resume()`, `playSfx(name, {volume, pitch})`, `startMusic(track)`, `setMusicIntensity(0..1)`, `stopMusic()`, `dispose()` — procedural reverb IR, 16-step sequencer (bass/lead/kick/hat) |
| `SFX` | named builders: `explosion, hit, laser, score, powerup, wallBounce, gameover, uiClick` — each a pure function of `(ctx, dest, {volume, pitch})` |
| `Noise` | `noise2(x,y)`, `noise3(x,y,z)`, `fbm(x,y,octaves)` |
| `Utils` | `clamp, lerp, damp, rand, randRange, randInt, pick, smoothstep, wrapAngle, angleLerp` |
| `GlassUI` | `createPanel({title, position})`, `show/hide`, `setStat(label, value)`, `dispose()` — injects the glass/neon token stylesheet once |
| `HUD` | `setScore/addScore/setLives/setWave/setCombo`, `dispose()` |
| `ProceduralTextures` | `makeGridTexture, makeGlowSprite, makeNebulaTexture, makeStarfieldTexture, makeCheckerTexture` — all return `THREE.CanvasTexture` with correct color space |

## 6. Compliance statement

- **Anti-Lazy Directive:** Every function will be written in full — no `// ... rest of logic`, no stubs, no `TODO`. Every import will resolve to an export that actually exists in the file it names, and every method called on a shared module is in the pinned API table above. A file written against an interface I never built is a defect, and I will not ship one.
- **Strict Memory Management:** All transient objects (projectiles, particles, rings, trails, text) come from pools; the `ParticleManager` enforces the 500 hard cap; particles and rings render as `InstancedMesh` (one draw call each); every geometry, material, texture, and composer pass is registered in a `MemoryRegistry` and explicitly `.dispose()`d on game teardown — verified by the `destroy()` contract, not by hope.
- **Sequential Output Protocol:** I work step-by-step in the order you trigger (plan → "Plan approved" → implementation), and if a file is truncated by output limits I stop cleanly at the cut point and resume at the exact character on "continue" — no preamble, no restart.
